paper_title: Leveraging ChatGPT As Text Annotation Tool For Sentiment Analysis
caption: Accuracy of ChatGPT VS VADER and TextBlob

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the evaluation of ChatGPT compared to various algorithms in terms of accuracy. The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled "VADER," "TextBlob," and "ChatGPT," and it is titled "Evaluation of ChatGPT VS various algorithms." The vertical axis represents accuracy, with a linear scale ranging from 0.4 to 1.0, incremented by 0.1. The bars corresponding to each algorithm are distinguished by differing styles: the "VADER" bar is outlined in black and approximates a value of 0.7, the "TextBlob" bar is hatched and reaches around 0.67, and the "ChatGPT" bar is solid green with an approximate value of 0.92. The bars do not appear to be sorted in any particular order, such as descending or alphabetical, nor is any bar specifically emphasized. There is a legend box on the bottom right corner of the plot to match different bars to their corresponding style.
